question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-12) + (-3) × 7
solution:
**Given:**

Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-12) + (-3) × 7

**Formula used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule: Brackets, Orders (i.e., powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction (from left to right).

**Calculation:**

(-9) - (-60) ÷ (-12) + (-3) × 7

⇒ (-9) - [(-60) ÷ (-12)] + [(-3) × 7]

⇒ (-9) - [5] + [-21]

⇒ -9 - 5 - 21

⇒ -14 - 21

⇒ -35

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
